data.title: 芙莉莲 · 现代咖啡馆
data.description: 都市露天咖啡座的圆桌旁，芙莉莲换上鼠尾草绿开衫与燕麦色针织上衣，一手托腮，另一手放在杯碟旁，认真研究拿铁上小猫形状的奶泡。近处的碟边放着一块杏仁饼干和茶匙，露台栏杆旁的花槽沿石砖路面延伸；越过栏杆，可见停靠的自行车和向街角退去的商店立面。遮篷滤过的日光从右前方照亮她的绿眼睛和奶泡，杯碟下有柔和接触阴影，远处街面稍亮——「只要用牛奶和奶泡，就能在杯子里画出猫咪的图案吗？现代人类发明出来的东西……意外地很有意思呢。」
data.location: 都市露天咖啡座，花槽栏杆外可见自行车与沿街店面
data.action: 右手托腮，左手放在桌上杯碟旁，好奇地研究小猫拿铁拉花；杯子留在桌上。
data.lighting: filtered daylight from the front right under the terrace awning; brighter street beyond
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, face, cup, terrace rail and street visible
data.promptProse: The tiny foam cat on her latte has captured Frieren's full attention at a modern-city cafe terrace. She rests her right cheek in her palm; her left hand lies beside the saucer, leaving the cup on the table. A sage-green cardigan and oatmeal knit top accompany charcoal trousers, with silver twintails brushing her shoulders. An almond cookie and teaspoon sit near the saucer along the round table's foreground edge. Beyond her chair, planted boxes follow the terrace railing over stone paving; a parked bicycle and successive shop facades carry the view toward the street corner. Frame her at eye level in a medium environmental portrait. Daylight filtered by the awning enters from the front right, catching green eyes and white foam. Gentle saucer shadows anchor the cup, while the uncovered street stays brighter.
